slices.focus: Discovering logistics and history podcasts to make repetitive collections work feel more companionable and focused
slices.summary: After overhearing grad students on a Boston train, Hannah adds long-form history and logistics podcasts to her audio rotation for relabeling and database cleanup — finding steadier pacing than public radio or indie rock alone.
